Send_error.description: Error returned by Teams for this recipient, lowercase. The name of the installedError input is removed so it cannot match.

Agent_not_installed.description: Teams rejects the card when the agent is not installed for the user (installedError = Fail). Any other failure, or a send that worked but was not logged, stays uncertain.

@if(greater(variables('uncertain'),0),'Una o piu consegne hanno esito incerto. Verificare prima di reinviare.',if(greater(variables('notInstalled'),0),'Alcuni destinatari non hanno ricevuto la card perche non hanno l''agente installato in Teams.',''))
